audience: developers, analysts and logistics planners who use Geoapify for geocoding, places and routing

useCases.title: Turn addresses into coordinates and back
useCases.text: The AI converts an address or place name into coordinates and address parts, or coordinates into the nearest address. It can also suggest addresses for a partial query.

useCases.title: Find places of a category in an area
useCases.text: The AI searches places by category within an area, optionally filtered by name, for example cafes near a square. It can open place details by place id.

useCases.title: Get the route, distance and travel time between points
useCases.text: The AI computes a route between waypoints for a travel mode and returns the distance, time and legs. You can compare modes such as driving and walking.

useCases.title: Find the area reachable within a time or distance
useCases.text: The AI computes an isoline from a point with a time or distance budget. It shows what area you can reach, for example for a delivery zone.

useCases.title: Look up the approximate location of an IP address
useCases.text: The AI reads the country, city and coordinates for an IP address. The result is approximate.
